ios.desc:
You built the app. Now hand it to someone.

You Get A Code connects directly to App Store Connect and fetches your offer codes and TestFlight links in comfort and style. No more downloading CSV files by hand. Hand them out wherever you are: at a meetup, at your booth, over dinner or in a DM. And the app remembers who got what, so no code goes out twice.

Every offer becomes a ticket. Hand out a code and a pair of scissors snips it off the list. After all, it should be fun to give someone your app.

• QR codes that open right to redemption in the App Store
• Siri: say “You Get A Code”. Yes, unleash your inner Oprah. Siri shows the next available code, ready to scan.
• Widgets with your next code on the Home Screen and on the Mac desktop
• NFC tags: put a reusable code or your TestFlight link on a tag, stick it on your booth or your laptop, and anyone with an iPhone just taps it, without opening any app
• Notes on every handout, so six months later you still know Alex got one after your talk
• iCloud sync: a code you hand out on your iPhone is gone on your iPad and Mac, too
• Pass a stack of codes to a friend or coworker, who hands them out with the app
• AirDrop: if you’re in each other’s contacts, hold your iPhones together and the code flies over
• TestFlight: public links as QR codes, and email invites for single testers
• App Store links work too, for any app
• Attach campaign information, so App Store Connect shows what worked
• See redemption counts from Apple’s reports, for subscription offers
• Codes from a CSV file, or typed in by hand, work too

Your codes stay on your devices and in your own iCloud. No tracking, no analytics, no server of ours in between.

Free for one entry. One purchase unlocks as many as you like, on all your devices and with Family Sharing.

Made by nxtbgthng, a small indie studio in Berlin.
